text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Nations adopts a decision urging Israel to withdraw fully from the Golan.
- President Assad received credentials of new ambassadors of China, Jordan, Finland, Australia and Pakistan.
- Prime Minister Zu'bi discusses bilateral cooperation with visiting Chinese delegation.
- Arab and international circles say Israeli premier Netanyahu follows a malicious ideology and does not respect the international will.
- Chief of French side in Lebanon's ceasefire monitoring committee says group's target is to protect civilians.
- Parliament speaker in talks with Moroccan parliament team.
